title: Supplementary Table S3. Principal component analysis of the nine SCImago IRIS indicators.
description: Variance explained, cumulative variance, eigenvalues, and indicator loadings for the nine principal components derived from winsorized and standardized IRIS indicators.
notes: 1. The analysis included 5,470 institutions with complete information across the nine IRIS indicators. | 2. Indicators were winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles and standardized before PCA. | 3. Component signs are conventional; interpretation depends on the relative direction and magnitude of loadings.
